process_issues.description: Every Bash invocation failed before it ran with 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. Three commands were tried and all failed: gh pr view 184, git rev-parse HEAD and git status --porcelain. Without Bash there was no PR diff, no file list, no intent and no head-SHA freshness check.

No reviewers were spawned because the change could not be determined, and reviewer subagents depend on the same broken Bash tool (gh pr diff / git diff). PR #184 was NOT reviewed, so this record must not be read as a clean review. Re-run after the runner's sandbox or user-namespace capability is fixed.
